name: Starlight Payment Gateway for Kaspi
author: Starlight Group

sections.description:
Starlight Payment Gateway for Kaspi adds a payment gateway for Kaspi Pay links to WooCommerce classic checkout and Checkout Blocks. Payment confirmation is manual: orders remain on hold until you check the actual funds in Kaspi Pay and update the order yourself.

For online stores in Kazakhstan, this WordPress plugin lets customers open the merchant’s existing payment link after placing an order. The merchant verifies the incoming payment before fulfilling the order.

Для магазинов Казахстана

Starlight Payment Gateway for Kaspi — плагин оплаты Каспи для WooCommerce на WordPress. Покупатель оформляет заказ в тенге и переходит по вашей ссылке Kaspi Pay. Продавец вручную проверяет поступление денег и подтверждает заказ. Бесплатная версия не выполняет автоматическую интеграцию с API банка.

You need a merchant payment link from Kaspi Pay. Only KZT orders are accepted. The link is shared by your sales point; this plugin does not automatically attach the amount or order number to it. Customers must check the recipient and pay the correct amount.

No Kaspi API access, API credentials, QR generation, automatic payment confirmation, refunds, Freemius registration or telemetry are included. No order limits or required account registration are imposed by this plugin.

Features

  • Original merchant payment links from Kaspi Pay.
  • KZT checkout with manual payment verification.
  • Classic Checkout, Checkout Blocks and HPOS order storage.
  • Protected payment instructions on order pages and customer email reminders.
  • Existing orders retain their saved payment instructions when settings change.
  • Translatable interface following the WordPress language, with translations delivered through WordPress.org language packs.

Optional full version

The plugin’s Full version tab links to KZ Pay by Starlight Group. The separate commercial plugin offers QR payments, individual API payment links and automatic payment-status checks. It requires merchant access to Kaspi Public QR API Scheme 1. The free gateway works without purchasing or registering for the full version.

Use Automatic, Русский or English on the Full version tab to choose the language of that description. Russian requires the plugin’s Russian WordPress.org language pack. If the pack is not installed, the tab explains this and uses the WordPress language. This display choice does not change WordPress, checkout or payment settings.

Support and contact

Contact Starlight Group at info@group-starlight.com. The Help tab provides direct buttons to email support and open our contact page.

Поддержка и связь со Starlight Group: info@group-starlight.com. Во вкладке «Помощь» доступны кнопки «Написать в поддержку» и «Связаться со Starlight Group».

Starlight Payment Gateway for Kaspi is an independent Starlight Group product. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or an official product of Kaspi.kz, WooCommerce or Automattic. All trademarks belong to their respective owners.

Privacy and external services

The plugin makes no server requests to Kaspi or Starlight Group and loads no external tracking assets. The public merchant payment link and buyer instructions are saved in WooCommerce settings and relevant order metadata. Existing order data stays in WooCommerce.

Only a buyer’s explicit click opens the merchant-provided Kaspi page. The plugin adds no customer details, order keys or amounts to that URL, and suppresses referrer transmission on that link. Kaspi handles the external payment page under its own terms.

The admin Help tab links to Kaspi’s payment-link guide, opens an email to info@group-starlight.com in your mail application, and links to https://group-starlight.com/contacts/. The Full version button links to https://group-starlight.com/products/kz-pay/. These are ordinary links, opened only when clicked. The plugin does not embed their pages, load remote assets or transmit analytics. Contact links contain no site, order or customer data; you choose what to include in your message.

Deactivation or removal retains settings and order history. No uninstall cleanup is performed.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install this plugin and open WooCommerce > Starlight Payments.
  3. Save your original merchant payment link and instructions. Verify the recipient.
  4. Enable the method. Always check incoming payments before fulfilling orders.
sections.faq:
Does clicking the link confirm payment?

No. You must check the actual incoming payment and match it to the order manually.

Why is my link rejected?

The initial version accepts only original HTTPS pay.kaspi.kz payment paths without query parameters, fragments, ports or URL credentials. Do not substitute a third-party redirect. Confirm your original link format with the developer if it is not accepted.

What happens if I change the link or order total?

Settings changes apply to new orders. Old orders retain their saved instructions. Changed amounts suppress the payment button and require manual assistance.

What happens when the commercial plugin is active?

The free gateway is hidden from new checkout. Old manual orders keep their instructions. There is no automatic conversion to API payments.

Does the free plugin require a Kaspi API key or a KZ Pay license?

No. You need your own Kaspi Pay merchant payment link. The plugin does not require an API key, a KZ Pay account or a license. Merchant eligibility and Kaspi service terms apply independently.

How do I replace an earlier unpublished package?

Deactivate the earlier package before installing this release. Its folder and main filename changed to starlight-payment-gateway-for-kaspi for directory submission. The gateway ID, settings option and order metadata are preserved, so existing manual orders retain their instructions. Do not activate both copies at once.

Where can I get help?

Use the Help tab to email info@group-starlight.com or open the Starlight Group contact page. Never send payment credentials, order keys or customer payment details.

How are translations installed?

Translations are managed at translate.wordpress.org and delivered as separate WordPress language packs when available. Set your WordPress language, then use Dashboard > Updates > Update Translations. Translation files are not bundled in the plugin ZIP. The Full version tab can display Russian when the plugin’s Russian pack is installed, even if the admin language is English.
sections.changelog:
1.0.4

  • Add prominent email-support and Starlight Group contact buttons to the Help tab.
  • Use info@group-starlight.com consistently in the plugin description and support FAQ.

1.0.3

  • Use the commercial payment-link button design with the local Kaspi logo, responsive sizing, hover styling and visible keyboard focus.

1.0.2

  • Give settings text fields and text areas a consistent responsive width and more room for checkout descriptions and buyer instructions.
  • Add captions for the settings, classic and Blocks checkout, buyer instructions, manual order verification, Help and Full version directory screenshots.

1.0.1

  • Rename the free directory product to Starlight Payment Gateway for Kaspi; preserve gateway settings and manual-order metadata.
  • Use automatic WordPress.org language loading and separate language packs instead of bundled translation catalogs.
  • Expand the Full version tab with bilingual benefits, a detailed comparison, trial information and connection requirements.
  • Add Automatic, Russian and English controls for the advertisement without changing WordPress or checkout language.
  • Improve English and Russian listing descriptions.

1.0.0

  • Initial independent manual payment-link gateway by Starlight Group.
  • Protected order instructions, native Checkout Blocks registration, and a dedicated Full version admin tab.
  • Public directory identity, original KZ Pay branding and a direct product-page link.

screenshots.caption: Settings: enable Kaspi Pay, configure your merchant link and customise checkout text and buyer instructions.
Classic checkout: Kaspi Pay payment-link method with a clear explanation of manual payment confirmation.
Checkout Blocks: Kaspi Pay payment-link method alongside the order summary.
Buyer instructions: order amount, payment link and a reminder that the shop confirms payment manually.
Order administration: an unpaid order remains On hold while the shop verifies the incoming Kaspi payment manually.
Help tab: how to accept orders with a Kaspi Pay link and verify payments manually.
